item: Approve a 60-day extension of the MPF CECL model (M06) validation, now overdue, with monthly back-testing and overlay review as compensating controls.
Approve continued restricted use of the PLMBS credit model (M14), rated Unsatisfactory, pending redevelopment targeted for Q1 2027.
Approve revised remediation dates for two past-due High findings on the prepayment (M02) and risk-based capital (M09) models.
Prepayment model (M02) is red on ongoing monitoring: actual speeds are running above model; a management overlay is in place and the vendor recalibration is in test.
Five High-risk EUAs have control gaps, two of which feed model inputs; owners have remediation plans due by year-end.
